children: (Nasdaq: HWC) will announce third quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, October 20, 2026 after the market closes. Management will host a conference call for analysts and investors at 3:30 p.m. Central Time on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, to review the results.
A live listen-only webcast of the call will be available under the Investor Relations section of Hancock Whitney’s website at
. To participate in the Q&A portion of the call, dial 833-461-5787, access code 662024071.
A replay of the conference call will be available under the Investor Relations section of our website.

Since the late 1800s, Hancock Whitney has embodied core values of Honor & Integrity, Strength & Stability, Commitment to Service, Teamwork, and Personal Responsibility. Hancock Whitney offices and financial centers in Mississippi, Alabama, Florida, Louisiana, and Texas offer comprehensive financial products and services, including traditional and online banking; commercial and small business banking; private banking; trust and investment services; healthcare banking; and mortgage services. The company also operates combined loan and deposit production offices in the greater metropolitan areas of Nashville, Tennessee, and Atlanta, Georgia. More information is available at
